race.comment: Consistent mare CABBUCIO (10) made it four minor placings from as many appearances this prep when an eye-catching second over 1800m at Randwick last start. Goes well at the mile and with a senior jock going on today she looks a great chance to collect an overdue win. DJAPANA (11) surprised most when she closed strongly to get up for third at $81.00 over 1400m at the Farm recently. Has won four races, all at today's trip. Up in grade but a definite contender. CHANGE MY ADDRESS (9) has done little in two runs this prep but is getting down in the weights now and can improve without surprising. COSMIC AVENGER (8) should be right at his peak fourth up and appears the next in line.
